assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated architectural reference for a fully modeled 3D platformer game prop. Create a complete Outer Banks waterfront fish-market building, alone on a plain neutral light-grey backdrop, three-quarter front view showing front and right side, entire roof and every foot visible with generous margin. Distinctive low, wide asymmetrical silhouette: a small two-storey weatherboard harbour office at the left joins a long single-storey fish auction hall at the right, with a deep open front veranda under a separate burnt-orange sloping metal canopy. About 2.2 times as wide as it is tall, compact enough to stand on a wooden quay. Chunky physically thick timber posts, deep exposed roof rafters, individually modeled weathered siding, inset framed windows, heavy shutters and large open service windows with wooden counters. A single carved wooden fish silhouette above the service hatch, no lettering. Rich dark navy roof and painted doors, salt-grey natural wood, muted burnt-orange canopy and fittings, soft copper-orange window glass. Exaggerated but believable high-end console platformer environment art, solid bevels and hand-built irregularities, detailed surface weathering without photographic clutter. Neutral studio lighting for accurate texturing; no baked nighttime lighting. Building only: no dock, ground slab, foundation pad, landscaping, water, background scenery, people, vehicles, loose crates, signage text or UI. The veranda is open at ground level with upright posts, no attached floor plane. Do not make a simple repeated rectangular blue shed. Show clear construction depth on all surfaces; opaque clean reference image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated architectural reference for a complete 3D platformer game prop. A distinctive open boat-repair shed from an Outer Banks working harbour, alone against a plain neutral light-grey backdrop. Show the entire building from a clear three-quarter front view, front and right side visible, all roof edges and support feet inside the frame with generous margin. One broad curved barrel-vault roof made from salt-worn dark navy corrugated metal panels, supported by thick weathered timber portal frames with burnt-orange iron brackets and exposed curved orange roof ribs. The front is completely open: two tall empty boat-repair bays separated by a substantial timber post, rear wall visible deep inside, big open side bays with diagonal timber bracing. An overhead orange hoist rail and chunky chain block hangs high inside; a fitted wooden workbench and a few wall-mounted tools at the rear establish use. Readable broad silhouette, visibly thick roof edges, deep modeled joinery, bolted plates, layered panel seams, solid bevels and subtly irregular aged timber. AAA stylized console platformer environment art with believable physical construction, matching a navy, burnt-orange and salt-grey waterfront, no yellow. The original flat ground is absent: there must be no floor slab, deck, dock, base platform, ground plane, terrain or foundation pad; all supporting post feet terminate at one common horizontal level for placement on a separate game quay. No boat, no loose crates, no people, no vegetation, no water, no background scenery, no lettering or UI. Neutral studio illumination for texture extraction, no dramatic nighttime shadows. Opaque clean reference image.
